blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: An embodied speaker's expressiveness depends not only on what is said, but also on how the voice sounds and how the body moves. However, existing joint speech-motion generation models are largely driven implicitly by transcript semantics or intermediate speech representations, offering little explicit control over motion hierarchy, body parts, or vocal style. To bridge this gap, we construct MotionSpeech, a structured benchmark for controllable joint speech-motion generation that includes transcripts, voice-style descriptions, and motion conditions at two hierarchical levels. Building on this benchmark, we propose DuoFlow, a dual-stream latent flow transformer that jointly denoises speech and motion under a shared noise level and a unified second-based temporal coordinate. Modality-specific residual connectors inject structured conditions into the corresponding streams, layer-wise bidirectional cross-modal attention coordinates their generation, and a monotonic phoneme pathway combines normalized progress anchors with CTC supervision to strengthen speech temporal modeling. DuoFlow provides a unified interface for fine-grained motion and vocal-style control and demonstrates the ability to synthesize high-quality, synchronized, and instruction-consistent speech-motion sequences.
blocks.zh: 一个被体现的发言者的表达性不仅取决于所说的话,还取决于声音的声音和身体的移动方式. 然而,现有的联合语音-动作生成模型大多被语义或中间语音表达所暗示地所驱动,对运动层次,身体部位,或相声风格几乎没有明显的控制. 为了弥补这一差距,我们构建了MotionSpeech,这是可控联合语音-动作生成的有条理的基准,包括文字记录、语音式描述和两个层次的运动条件。 在这个基准的基础上,我们提出DuoFlow,一种双流潜流变压器,在共同噪声水平下联合去声和运动,以及统一的二基时间坐标. 针对模式的剩余连接器将结构化的条件注入相应的流中,分层双向双模式的注意协调其生成,单调的电话线路将正常的进度锚与CTC监督结合起来,以加强语音时间模型的制作。 DuoFlow为精细分泌的动作和相声式控制提供了统一的界面,并展示了合成高质量,同步,与指令相协调的语音-相声相声序列的能力.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: An embodied speaker communicates through speech and movement at the same time: an utterance may be accompanied by a rhythmic beat, an illustrative hand gesture, or a subtle postural shift [ 40 , 32 ] . In many applications the verbal content is fixed in advance, as in a script, a voice-over, or an avatar’s dialogue. The central question then shifts from what is said to how it is delivered: how the utterance should sound, and how the body should move as it is spoken. Because conversational gesture varies considerably across speakers and contexts [ 15 , 50 ] , a single plausible realization is insufficient when a particular delivery is intended, and user intent can be difficult to reconcile with fine-grained motion and timbre. In practice, users can readily express an overall gestural intent but cannot be expected to enumerate the temporally ordered actions of individual body parts. A useful control interface should therefore cover hierarchical levels of granularity, expanding concise high-level guidance into detailed, coherent motion while also following fine-grained instructions when they are available.
blocks.zh: 被体现的演讲者通过演讲和动作同时进行交流:演讲时可以伴有节奏节拍,示意手势,或微妙的姿势转变[40,32]. 在许多应用中,口头内容是事先固定的,如脚本、语音或阿凡达的对话。 然后,中心问题从所说的话转向如何表达:言论应如何发出,以及机构应如何按口号移动。 由于在演讲者和场合[15,50]之间对话姿态差异很大,当某项特定交付是意图时,单一的可能实现是不够的,用户的意图可能难以与精细的动作和心跳调和. 实际上,用户可以随时表达总体的地心意图,但不能期望用户列举个别身体部分按时间顺序采取的行动。 因此,一个有用的控制界面应涵盖颗粒度的分级水平,将简明的高级指导扩展为详细、连贯的动作,同时在可获得精确指示时也遵循这些指示。

blocks.en: Existing systems generally lack such an interface because control remains fragmented across two largely separate paradigms. On the speech side, instruction-following text-to-speech can follow vocal instructions but does not synthesize body motion [ 11 ] . On the motion side, prompt-based full-body control, caption-guided gestures, and joint-level spatial constraints have substantially advanced motion controllability [ 4 , 12 , 41 ] , but still use speech that has already been produced as the conditioning input. Cascading a speech generator with a motion generator combines the two outputs but retains a one-way interface: the motion stage receives completed audio, so a motion instruction supplied at that stage cannot shape the speech upstream. Early and recent joint speech–gesture studies have demonstrated the feasibility of joint generation [ 3 , 45 , 37 , 19 , 18 , 36 ] ; joint speech–face generation [ 27 , 30 ] and dialogue systems supporting discrete body-action directives [ 53 ] provide related precedents. However, these interfaces still do not allow users to control both motion and vocal expression through instructions.
blocks.zh: 现有系统一般缺乏这种接口,因为控制仍然分散在两个基本上独立的范式中。 在语音方面,遵循指令的文本对语音可以遵循声调指令,但不合成身体运动[11]. 在运动方面,即时的全体控制,字幕制导手势,以及联动级别的空间约束,具有实质性的高级运动控制性[4,12,41],但仍使用已经制作的语音作为调节输入. 将语音生成器和运动生成器混合在一起,但保留了单向接口:运动阶段接收完成的音频,因此该阶段提供的运动指令无法左右语音的上游. 早期和最近的联合演讲 -- -- 地理研究证明联合生成[3、45、37、19、18、36]的可行性;联合演讲 -- -- 面代[27、30]和支持单独机构行动指令的对话系统[53]提供了相关的先例。 然而,这些接口仍然不允许用户通过指令控制运动和声波表达.

blocks.en: Turning joint generation into controllable generation raises three challenges. First, supervision for such an interface does not yet exist. Existing co-speech corpora provide audio, transcripts, motion, and in some cases semantic or emotion labels [ 32 , 31 ] , while caption-guided motion work adds textual gesture supervision [ 12 ] ; however, none aligns the same speech–motion target with hierarchical motion descriptions and a voice description. Second, semantic condition guidance is complex: speech and motion differ in temporal resolution, so their conditions must be injected accurately, and the model must bridge the gap between coarse user intent and fine-grained motion control. Third, evaluation remains incomplete: existing work [ 26 , 31 , 39 ] does not directly evaluate whether jointly generated speech and motion follow their respective voice and motion instructions, motivating a unified benchmark for quality evaluation.
blocks.zh: 将联合发电转变为可控制的发电,提出了三个挑战。 首先,还没有对这种接口进行监督。 现有的同声体(co-speech corpora)提供音频,语录,运动,以及在某些情况下提供语义或情感标签[32,31],而字幕指导的运动工作则增加了文字手势监督[12];然而,没有任何一个将同声体-运动目标与等级运动描述和语音描述一致. 第二,语义条件指导很复杂:言语和运动在时间分辨率上有所不同,所以它们的条件必须准确注射,模型必须弥补粗糙的用户意图和细纹运动控制之间的空隙. 第三,评价仍不完整:现有工作[26,31,39]没有直接评价联合生成的语音和动作是否遵循各自的声音和动作指示,激励质量评价的统一基准.

blocks.en: To this end, we construct MotionSpeech and propose DuoFlow (Figure ). MotionSpeech builds on existing public datasets [ 31 , 1 ] and refines four high-quality annotation channels: a coarse motion description (L1), a fine-grained description of body-part actions and their temporal order (L2), a voice description (AUDCAP), and a transcript. On this basis, we propose DuoFlow, a dual-stream latent flow transformer. The model denoises motion and audio latents in parallel under a shared noise level and a unified time coordinate measured in seconds. Bidirectional cross-modal attention in every block allows the two streams to exchange information, while modality-specific residual connectors adapt the structured condition for each stream. A dedicated monotonic phoneme-alignment pathway adds a normalized progress anchor to the phoneme context and uses phoneme-CTC supervision to make intermediate audio states follow the transcript order without forced phoneme boundaries. Progressive audio-only pretraining followed by joint speech–motion training gives the model strong generalization capability.
blocks.zh: 为此,我们构建MotionSpeech,并提议DuoFlow(图). 动议 演讲以现有的公共数据集[31,1]为基础,并完善了四个高质量的注释通道:粗体运动描述(L1),身体部分动作及其时间顺序的精细描述(L2),语音描述(AUDCAP),以及笔录. 在此基础上,我们提出DuoFlow,一种双流潜流变流器. 模型在共享噪声水平和以秒计的统一时间坐标下平行地使运动和音频潜伏. 每个区块的双向跨模式关注使得两个流可以交换信息,而模式特定的剩余连接器则适应每个流的结构条件. 专用的单音节电话调制路径为电话上下文增加了一个正常的进度主播,并使用电话调制-CTC监督,使中间音频状态在不强制电话调制界限的情况下遵循录音记录。 渐进式的音频预训,然后是联合语音-运动训练,使模式具有强大的通俗化能力。

blocks.en: Our contributions are threefold. (i) We present MotionSpeech, a four-channel structured benchmark for fine-grained controllable joint generation, comprising 34,950 clips (approximately 125.2 hours). (ii) We propose DuoFlow, the first joint speech–motion generation framework to support hierarchical motion and voice-condition control. (iii) We establish a unified evaluation protocol for generation quality, cross-modal synchronization, and text–motion consistency. Experiments show that DuoFlow is the only one with a native unified interface that simultaneously supports end-to-end joint generation, fine-grained motion control, and free-form vocal-style control, while maintaining strong motion quality, speech–motion coordination, and instruction consistency.
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献有三个方面。 (i) 我们提出MotionSpeech,这是精细可控联合发电的四频道结构化基准,包括34 950个剪辑(约125.2小时)。 (二)我们提出DuoFlow,这是第一个支持等级运动和语音条件控制的联合演讲-运动生成框架. (三)我们建立统一的生成质量,跨模式同步,文本运动一致性的评价协议. 实验显示,DuoFlow是唯一一个具有本土统一界面的,同时支持端对端联合生成,精细纹理的运动控制,以及自由形态的声调风格控制,同时保持强运动质量,语音–运动协调,以及指令一致性.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Co-speech motion generation.
blocks.zh: 2.1 共声运动生成。

blocks.en: Given speech, co-speech models synthesize body movement: early cross-modal translation [ 15 ] , trimodal text–audio–speaker conditioning with the FGD metric [ 50 ] , and large annotated corpora with semantic baselines [ 32 , 31 ] . Architectures advanced from regression to diffusion, state-space, and flow models [ 31 , 47 , 35 ] . Recent systems add caption- or example-level semantics [ 12 , 54 , 43 , 34 ] . However, these methods all treat speech as a conditioning input and do not support joint speech–motion generation.
blocks.zh: 基于语音,共声模型合成了体动:早期跨模式翻译[15],三模式文本–audio–语句调配FGD度量 [50],大注音的corpora带语义基线[32,31]. 结构从回归发展到扩散、状态空间和流动模型[31、47、35]。 最近的系统增加了标题-或实例级语义[12,54,43,34]. 然而,这些方法都把语音当作一种条件性输入,不支持联合语音-运动生成.

blocks.en: 2.2 Joint speech–motion generation.
blocks.zh: 2.2 联合演讲-运动生成。

blocks.en: Match-TTSG [ 37 ] pioneered joint flow synthesis of speech and upper-body gesture in one process; FastTalker [ 19 ] reaches real-time joint generation by reusing speech features; Gelina [ 18 ] unifies the two modalities with interleaved discrete tokens and style cloning; Motion-Omni [ 36 ] emits full-body motion natively from dialogue hidden states with an open evaluation protocol; RapVerse [ 5 ] targets vocals and whole-body dance; ViBES [ 53 ] lets a dialogue agent accept discrete body-action directives; DyaPlex [ 38 ] targets streaming duplex conversation. Adjacent joint models cover faces, audio-video, or agent stacks [ 6 , 22 , 27 , 9 , 10 , 52 , 24 ] . Connectionist temporal classification (CTC) marginalizes monotonic paths between frame sequences and unsegmented label sequences [ 17 ] ; we use it only as an auxiliary training signal on latent audio states, rather than as an autoregressive decoder or an inference-time forced aligner. These systems establish that joint generation is possible and increasingly efficient, but their interfaces either expose no user-facing motion semantics at all (Match-TTSG, FastTalker, Gelina, Motion-Omni) or trigger discrete behaviors instead of span- and part-level instructions (ViBES).
blocks.zh: Match-TTSG [37]在一个过程中率先对语音和上体姿态进行联合流动合成; FastTalker [19] 通过重用语音特征实现实时联合生成; Gelina [18] 将两种模式统一为互离的离散符号和风格克隆; Motion-Omni [36] 将全身运动从对话的隐藏状态中原生地释放出来,并有一个开放的评价协议; RapVerse [5] 瞄准声学和全身舞蹈; ViBES [53] 让对话代理人接受离散的肢体动作指令; DyaPlex [38] 目标流双人对话。 相邻联合型号封面,音频-视频,或代理堆叠[6,22,27,9,10,52,24]. 连接时间分类(CTC)将帧序列和无分隔标签序列之间的单调路径边缘化[17];我们仅将其作为潜伏音频状态上的辅助训练信号,而不是自动解码器或推论时间强制对调器. 这些系统确定联合生成是可能的,并且越来越有效率,但是它们的接口要么完全没有暴露出用户的造型运动语义(Match-TTSG,FastTalker,Gelina,Motion-Omni),要么触发离散行为而不是跨和部分级指令(ViBES).

blocks.en: 2.3 Controllable multimodal generation.
blocks.zh: 2.3 可控制的多式联运生成。

blocks.en: On the speech side, CosyVoice 2 [ 11 ] provides streaming zero-shot cloning and instruction-following speech, and MGM-Omni [ 44 ] stabilizes long-horizon personalized timbre; both control a single modality. LTX-2 [ 20 ] generates synchronized audio-video with a two-stream DiT and modality-CFG, and unified music–motion models [ 48 , 51 ] align rhythmic latents across modalities; pixel-space audio-video and music-driven synchronization, however, do not provide semantically structured 3D motion amenable to part- and span-level instructions. Streaming systems optimize latency rather than controllability [ 55 , 23 ] . DuoFlow follows this line of research by adopting joint latent flow generation as its mechanism and constructing a unified control interface.
blocks.zh: 在语音方面,CosyVoice 2 [11] 提供流畅的零镜头克隆和指令跟踪语音,MGM-Omni [44] 稳定了长视距的个性化ti;两者都控制着单一模式. LTX-2 [20] 以双流DiT和模式-CFG生成同步音频-视频,统一音乐-运动模型[48,51]将节奏潜伏在各种模式之间;然而,像素-空间音频-视频和音乐驱动的同步并不能提供适合部分和跨级指令的精密结构的3D运动. 流化系统优化耐久性而非可控性[55,23]. DuoFlow遵循这一研究路线,采用联合潜在流生成作为其机制,并构建统一的控制接口。

blocks.en: 3 The MotionSpeech Benchmark
blocks.zh: 3 动议发言基准

blocks.en: 3.1 Data and Hierarchical Annotations
blocks.zh: 3.1 数据和等级说明

blocks.en:
MotionSpeech couples full-body conversational motion with multi-scale hierarchical spoken-language annotations.
It selects and integrates samples from two complementary sources of natural talking–gesturing behavior:
(i) BEAT2 [ 31 ] , a studio-capture corpus pairing SMPL-X body motion with expressive English speech, and
(ii) Seamless Interaction [ 1 ] , an improvised conversational corpus of spontaneous multi-speaker dialogues with rich prosodic variation.

动感Speech夫妇全体对话动作,多层次分级的口语说明.
它从两个互补的自然对话-诱导行为来源中选择和整合样本:
(一)BEAT2 [31],工作室-摄像头将SMPL-X体动与表达式英语语音配对,
(二)无缝互动[1],一种自发多语对话的即兴对话体,具有丰富的偏差.

blocks.en: Figure 2 : MotionSpeech data and annotation construction. Each source segment pairs an SMPL-X motion sequence with its speech waveform and transcript. The annotation pipeline adds hierarchical motion descriptions and a voice description, followed by manual verification and correction.
blocks.zh: 图2 : MotionSpeech数据与注释构建. 每个源段将一个SMPL-X运动序列与它的语音波形和笔录对齐. 注释管道增加了分级运动描述和语音描述,然后是人工核实和校正.

blocks.en: Each segment is annotated with a four-channel structured caption: (1) L1 coarse motion , describing overall body dynamics and gestures; (2) L2 fine-grained motion , describing temporally ordered body-part actions and directions; (3) the re-recognized transcript ; and (4) AUDCAP voice , describing timbre and delivery style. The four tagged channels can be parsed independently.
blocks.zh: 每个部分都附加一个四声道结构的字幕:(1) L1粗糙运动,描述整体身体动态和手势;(2) L2细纹运动,描述按时间顺序排列的身体部分动作和方向;(3) 重新识别的笔录;(4) AUDCAP语音,描述胸腔和交付风格. 四个标记的频道可以独立解析.

blocks.en: 3.2 Dataset Construction
blocks.zh: 3.2 数据集建设

blocks.en: MotionSpeech is constructed in three steps.
blocks.zh: MotionSpeech分三步构建.

blocks.en:
(i) Segmentation and pairing. Both source corpora are cut into uniform 387-frame windows with paired SMPL-X motion sequences and waveforms.
Motion is represented as 387 × 333 387\times 333 features (global translation plus 55 joints in 6D rotation), and audio is resampled to 16 kHz mono.
blocks.zh:
(i) 分割和配对。 两个源头的corpora被切成统一的387帧窗,配对为SMPL-X运动序列和波形.
Motion代表作387×333 387\times 333功能(6D旋转中全球翻译加上55关节),音频被重印为16 kHz单曲.

blocks.en: (ii) Hierarchical caption annotation. For every segment, GLM-5.3-Flash watches the rendered motion and writes (a) an L1 summary of coarse posture and gesture style and (b) an L2 sequential, body-part-level description. Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B-Instruct analyzes the speech waveform to produce the AUDCAP voice description, while the spoken content is retained as the re-recognized transcript channel. Human annotators then inspect every four-channel record against the source motion and audio and correct inaccurate, incomplete, or malformed descriptions.
blocks.zh: (二) 等级说明。 对于每一段,GLM-5.3-Flash观看了变换的运动,并写下(a) L1粗糙姿态和手势风格的总结,以及(b) L2顺序的,身体部位的描述. Qune3-Omni-30B-A3B-Instruct 分析语音波形以产生AUDCAP语音描述,而口语内容则保留为重新识别的语录通道. 人类的注释员然后对照源动和音频检查每一个四通道的记录,并纠正不准确、不完整或错误的描述。

blocks.en: (iii) Tokenization and latent precomputation. Before training, phoneme sequences are produced by a grapheme-to-phoneme tokenizer; motion and speech are encoded into latents by the motion VAE (Section 4.2 ) and the AudioLDM2 VAE [ 33 ] , respectively; text conditions are encoded by the Gemma text encoder and mapped by a feature-fusion module into trainable joint-condition features.
blocks.zh: (三) 切入和潜在的预算。 在训练前,电话序列由石墨至手机的标注器生成;运动和语音分别由运动VAE(第4.2节)和AudioLDM2 VAE[33]编码为潜伏物;文本条件由Gemma文本编码器编码,并用特性集成模块映射为可训练的联合条件特性.

blocks.en: 4 DuoFlow
blocks.zh: 4 杜欧花

blocks.en: Figure 3 : Overview of DuoFlow. The selected motion instruction, transcript, and voice description form a shared semantic condition for two coupled latent streams. A frozen phoneme encoder supplies a separate audio condition. Its normalized phoneme-progress anchor preserves token order, and phoneme-CTC heads supervise the audio states at multiple depths during training only. Each dual-stream block combines self-attention, condition cross-attention, phoneme cross-attention, and bidirectional speech–motion exchange. Frozen decoders reconstruct the denoised latents as a waveform and a motion sequence.
blocks.zh: 图3:杜鹃花概览. 选定的运动指令、记录和语音描述构成两个连结的潜流的共同语义条件。 一个冷冻的电话编码器提供单独的音频条件. 其规范化的电话Me-进步主播保留了符号顺序,电话me-CTC头只在训练期间在多个深度监督音频状态. 每个双流区块结合了自我关注,条件交叉关注,电话我交叉关注,以及双向语音-运动交换. 冰冻解码器将解码的潜质重建成波形和运动序列.

blocks.en: 4.1 Task and Model Overview
blocks.zh: 4.1 任务和模式概览

blocks.en:
For each segment, MotionSpeech provides a transcript s s , a voice description c voice c^{\mathrm{voice}} , and paired motion descriptions c L1 c^{\mathrm{L1}} and c L2 c^{\mathrm{L2}} . The model receives exactly one motion description at a time. Letting ℓ ∈ { L1 , L2 } \ell\in\{\mathrm{L1},\mathrm{L2}\} denote the selected granularity, its structured condition is c ℓ = ( c ℓ , s , c voice ) c_{\ell}=\big(c^{\ell},s,c^{\mathrm{voice}}\big) .
Conditioned on c ℓ c_{\ell} , DuoFlow learns the joint distribution of a speech waveform y a y^{a} and a synchronized full-body motion sequence y m y^{m} . Frozen modality encoders map paired speech and motion to continuous latents z 0 a z_{0}^{a} and z 0 m z_{0}^{m} . A coupled transformer estimates both latent trajectories in one denoising process, after which the corresponding frozen decoders recover the waveform and motion. Keeping two streams allows each modality to retain its own representation and temporal resolution, while coupling them throughout generation coordinates delivery decisions before either output is finalized.

blocks.en: 4.2 Motion VAE
blocks.zh: 4.2 VAE动议

blocks.en: We adapt the MotionStreamer causal codec [ 46 ] to encode full-body motion into continuous latents. Each 30-Hz SMPL-X frame contains root translation and 55 joint rotations in 6D, yielding 333 features. After normalization, independent body, left-hand, and right-hand VAE branches encode the corresponding channel groups into 128, 64, and 64 latent channels. Causal convolutions compress time by a factor of three; concatenating the branches gives a 256-dimensional, 10-Hz motion sequence. The codec is trained with calibrated reconstruction and KL losses, with extra emphasis on root translation and rotation. We freeze it during flow training, use posterior samples as motion targets, and decode the generated latents back into SMPL-X motion.
blocks.zh: 我们修改了MotionStreamer因果编码器 [46] 将全身运动编码为连续潜伏. 每个30-Hz SMPL-X帧包含根翻译和55个6D的联动旋转,产生333个特性. 正常化后,独立体,左手,右手的VAE分支将相应的频道组编码为128,64,64潜伏频道. Causal convolution 压缩时间的因数为3;调和分支给出256维,10Hz运动序列. 解码器通过校准重建及KL损失来训练,特别着重于root翻译和旋转. 我们在流动训练中冻结它,使用后置样本作为运动目标,并解码生成的潜伏物回到SMPL-X运动中.

blocks.zh: 4.3 结构化输入条件

blocks.en: The shared semantic condition c ℓ c_{\ell} combines the selected motion description, transcript, and voice description (AUDCAP). The transcript also provides a separate phoneme condition for the audio stream. Together, these conditions specify what to say, how the voice should sound, and how the body should move.

Each annotated segment i i is expanded into two training instances, ( c i , L1 , y i m , y i a ) \big(c_{i,\mathrm{L1}},y_{i}^{m},y_{i}^{a}\big) and ( c i , L2 , y i m , y i a ) \big(c_{i,\mathrm{L2}},y_{i}^{m},y_{i}^{a}\big) . blocks.en: Native-rate dual streams. The motion and audio latents are projected into two separate Transformer streams. Within each block, each stream first models its own temporal context and reads its modality-adapted text condition. The streams then exchange information bidirectionally through audio-to-motion and motion-to-audio cross-attention, with timestep-conditioned gates regulating the interaction strength throughout denoising.

The shared clock, shared noise level, and bidirectional attention together enable the model to learn synchronization from paired data.

blocks.en: Training regimes. The model adopts a progressive two-stage training regime. Stage 1 disables the motion stream and cross-modal interaction, and trains the speech and pronunciation pathways on speech-only data using audio flow matching and phoneme-CTC supervision. Stage 2 activates both streams and their bidirectional interaction, optimizing both flow-matching losses and the phoneme-CTC regularizer on the expanded MotionSpeech conditioning instances. To preserve the speech branch’s generalization ability, we sample 10% of Stage 2 training batches from the Stage 1 speech-pretraining dataset.
blocks.zh: 培训制度。 该模式采用渐进式两阶段培训制度。 第1阶段禁用运动流和跨模式交互,并利用音频流匹配和电话me-CTC监管,在语音唯一数据上培训语音和发音路径. 第2阶段激活了流及其双向交互,优化了在扩大的MotionSpeech调制例上的流量匹配损失和电话-CTC调节器。 为了保持语音分支的通俗化能力,我们从第一阶段语音预训数据集中抽取了第二阶段培训的10%的批次。

blocks.en: Inference. Given a transcript, a voice description, and one L1 or L2 motion instruction, we form c ℓ c_{\ell} and encode it with the text encoder to obtain the semantic condition. The transcript is also converted into a phoneme sequence through grapheme-to-phoneme (G2P) conversion and encoded by the frozen phoneme encoder to provide the audio stream’s phoneme context. For a target duration, we set the latent lengths at the native motion and audio rates and initialize both streams with independent Gaussian noise. The coupled transformer jointly updates the two latent sequences over a shared noise schedule from σ = 1 \sigma=1 to 0 0 using 30 Euler steps with classifier-free guidance. Finally, the frozen motion decoder reconstructs 30-Hz SMPL-X motion, while the frozen audio VAE decoder and vocoder reconstruct a 16-kHz waveform matched to the target duration. The phoneme-progress anchor remains active during inference; the auxiliary CTC heads are removed.
blocks.zh: 推论. 根据一个记录,一个语音描述和一个L1或L2运动指令,我们形成cl c_{\ell}并用文本编码器编码,以获得语义条件. 笔录也通过石墨对手机(G2P)的转换转换而成一个电话me序列,由冷冻的电话me编码器编码,以提供音频流的电话上下文. 在目标时间内,我们设定了 潜在长度的原生运动和音频速率, 并初始化两个溪流 独立的高斯噪音。 组合式变压器通过一个共享的噪声表,使用30个欧拉步骤,用无分类器的制导,将两个潜在序列从= = 1\sigma=1到0联合更新. 最后,被冻结的运动解码器重建了30-Hz SMPL-X运动,而被冻结的音频VAE解码器和vocoder重建了16k. Hz波形与目标持续时间匹配. 在推论期间,电话-进展主锚仍然活跃;反恐委员会辅助负责人被移除。

blocks.en: 5 Experiments
blocks.zh: 5 实验

blocks.en: 5.1 Setup
blocks.zh: 5.1 设置

blocks.en: Data. MotionSpeech contains 34,950 12.9-second segments (approximately 125.2 hours), including 17,907 BEAT2 clips and 17,043 Seamless Interaction clips. The fixed split contains 27,957 training, 3,501 validation, and 3,492 test segments.
blocks.zh: 数据. 动议 演讲包含34,950个12.9秒的片段(约125.2小时),包括17,907个BEAT2片段和17,043个无缝互动片段. 固定拆分包含27,957个训练,3,501个验证,以及3,492个测试段.

blocks.en: Baselines. CosyVoice 2 [ 11 ] followed by MambaTalk [ 47 ] forms the cascade baseline. Match-TTSG [ 37 ] jointly synthesizes speech and gesture through monotonic phoneme alignment and conditional flow matching. Motion-Omni [ 36 ] is an end-to-end spoken-dialogue model that jointly outputs speech and full-body motion.
blocks.zh: 基线。 CosyVoice 2 [11],然后是MambaTalk [47] 构成级联基线. Match-TTSG [37] 通过单调的电话调和和有条件的流量匹配,联合合成语音和手势. Motion-Omni [36]是一个端对端的口语对话模式,联合输出语音和全身运动.

blocks.en: Metrics. We use seven headline metrics. For speech, WER is computed with Whisper large-v3-turbo [ 42 ] , while SpkSim is the cosine similarity between WavLM-base-plus-SV [ 7 ] embeddings of generated and reference speech and serves as a proxy for reference-speaker timbre similarity. For motion, Fréchet Gesture Distance (FGD) uses the official EMAGE/PantoMatrix AESKConv features [ 31 ] , and foot skating is the percentage of contact frames whose horizontal foot speed exceeds 0.10 m/s. BC Gap is the absolute mean-BC difference between generated and reference motions, both paired with reference speech. L1 and L2 Global PairAcc use the same frozen CLaM-H text–motion evaluator [ 8 , 29 ] .
blocks.zh: 度量衡. 我们用七个头条标尺 对于语音,WER用Whisper大V3-turbo [42]计算,而SpkSim则是WavLM-base-plus-SV [7]嵌入生成语和参考语的同位素相似性,并作为参考语的tibre相似性的代称. 对于运动,Fréchet手势距离(FGD)采用官方的EMAGE/PantoMatrix AESKConv特性[31],脚滑冰是指水平脚速超过0.10米/秒的接触框的百分比. BC差距(BC Gap)是生成的和参考运动之间的绝对平均-BC差异,两者都与参考演讲对齐. L1和L2 Global PairAcc使用同样被冻结的CLAM-H文本–运动评价器[8,29].

blocks.en: Implementation details. DuoFlow uses eight coupled Transformer blocks for both motion and audio, with width 1,024, 32 attention heads, and head dimension 32 in each stream. Frozen modality codecs provide 256-channel motion and 128-channel audio latents. A frozen Gemma-3 encoder [ 14 ] supplies multi-level text features through cross-attention, while residual connectors adapt them to the two streams. A frozen AudioLDM2 phoneme encoder [ 33 ] , the progress anchor, and auxiliary CTC heads at all eight audio blocks provide pronunciation and temporal supervision. Stage 1 trains the audio stream on the Emilia [ 21 ] subset for 100,000 steps, and Stage 2 jointly trains both streams on MotionSpeech for 200,000 steps. Both stages use eight A100 GPUs, 8-bit AdamW, a per-GPU batch size of 4, 2,000 warm-up steps, and cosine scheduling. The Stage 1 learning rate is × 10 − 4 2\!\times\!10^{-4} ; Stage 2 uses × 10 − 4 2\!\times\!10^{-4} for the motion branch and × 10 − 5 1\!\times\!10^{-5} for the audio branch. Inference uses 30 Euler steps.

blocks.en: 5.2 Generation Quality, Control, and Efficiency
blocks.zh: 5.2 生成质量、控制和效率

blocks.en: We compare speech and motion quality, instruction compatibility, and speech–motion alignment across systems (Table 2 ), and report generation latency in Table 3 . Figure 4 complements these metrics with qualitative examples under coarse L1 and fine-grained L2 motion instructions. Speech quality. Table 2 shows that DuoFlow achieves the lowest WER (4.71%) and highest SpkSim (0.94) among the reported systems. The CosyVoice 2–MambaTalk cascade, built on CosyVoice 2’s pretrained speech-synthesis model, maintains good WER and preserves speaker similarity when using a reference audio for timbre. The lightweight Match-TTSG does not generalize its speech capability. Although Motion-Omni, for which no loadable weights are available, uses the same two-stage training strategy as DuoFlow, an inefficient learning pathway leads to the performance gap, while DuoFlow’s phoneme pathway provides a stronger representation for the speech branch.

blocks.en: Motion quality and instruction compatibility. DuoFlow obtains the lowest FGD (0.75) and foot-skating rate (29.61%), alongside L1/L2 PairAcc of 87.43%/90.40%. The structured condition supplies either a global or a detailed motion description to both streams, and the observed scores are consistent with generated motion matching both levels of description. For MambaTalk, which does not accept L1/L2, the scores measure compatibility rather than instruction following. Match-TTSG remains limited by model capacity.

blocks.en: Speech–motion alignment. DuoFlow combines coupled streams, a shared temporal coordinate, and a joint flow objective, and achieves a BC Gap of 0.14, indicating strong generation consistency. Match-TTSG achieves the lowest BC Gap (0.06), effectively capturing speech–motion rhythm; however, its weaker spatial, physical, and instruction-level motion fidelity shows that beat alignment does not equal natural motion trajectories or good semantic matching.

blocks.en: 5.3 Ablation Studies
blocks.zh: 5.3 阅读研究

blocks.en: Phoneme conditioning. Table 4 isolates changes to the Stage 1 phoneme path. Adding the phoneme branch reduces WER from 9.45% to 6.02%, suggesting that an explicit pronunciation representation complements the shared semantic text condition. Adding the progress anchor together with multi-depth CTC further reduces WER to 5.29%. The anchor supplies relative phoneme order, while CTC encourages a monotonic transcript-compatible path in intermediate audio states.

blocks.en: Training schedule. Compared with single-stage joint training, audio pretraining followed by joint training reduces WER from 38.76% to 4.71% and improves SpkSim from 0.82 to 0.94 (Table 5 ). The same schedule improves FGD, BC Gap, and both PairAcc scores. This result indicates that learning an effective speech prior before modality coupling is necessary and is consistent with preserving motion quality and description compatibility during joint training.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We presented MotionSpeech, a four-channel benchmark that aligns a transcript and vocal-style description with coarse- and fine-grained motion intents, together with DuoFlow, a dual-stream latent flow framework for controllable joint speech–motion generation. The framework coordinates native-rate speech and motion latents through a shared noise level, a common second-based temporal coordinate, modality-specific residual connectors, and layer-wise bidirectional interaction. It strengthens speech temporal awareness through a monotonic phoneme-alignment pathway that combines a learned normalized progress anchor with training-only CTC supervision. The results show that an end-to-end model can produce intelligible speech, realistic and synchronized full-body motion, consistency with both levels of motion instruction, and controllable vocal delivery. This work establishes a unified interface for multimodal motion and speech control, while improving physical contact fidelity and extending the framework to streaming generation remain future directions.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了MotionSpeech,一个四频道基准,将记录和声调式描述与粗糙和精细的动作意向相结合,以及DuoFlow,这是可控联合演讲-动作生成的双流潜流框架。 该框架通过共享噪音水平、共同的二基时间坐标、特定模式的剩余连接器以及分层双向相互作用,协调本地-比率的语音和运动潜伏。 它通过一个单调的电话-调和路径,将学习的常态化进展主锚与只培训的反恐委员会监督结合起来,从而加强语音时间意识。 结果显示,端对端模型可以产生通晓的语音,现实和同步的全身运动,与运动指令的两级一致,以及可控的声波传递. 这项工作为多式联运和语音控制建立了一个统一接口,同时改进物理接触忠心,将框架扩大到流体一代仍然是未来的方向。
